request.prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create ONE square 1024x1024 image. The first 4 attached images are STYLE references only (frame, flat shapes, palette); do not copy their birds. The last 2 attached image(s) are earlier versions of this same bird icon: improve on them as the art director's change below says. Save the generated PNG into the current working directory as out.png and reply with only its path. This is variation 3; vary the composition a little. Image brief:
Flat geometric bird icon in a Mondrian / De Stijl spirit, matching the reference images. A thick navy square frame (#0B0F24) around an ivory field (#FAF6EE). Right-facing head-and-upper-breast portrait. The bird is a bold navy silhouette with a few flat color fields; it may run off the bottom and left edges of the frame only, and leaves clear ivory space between the bill tip, crest and the frame. One simple round eye. Use only these colors: navy #0B0F24, ivory #FAF6EE, chrome yellow #F7B902, vermilion #C7301C, Klein blue #002FA7, slate #5E6178. Three or four colors in total. No gradients, shading, texture, outlines of feather detail, scenery, text or labels. Simple shapes that stay readable at 32 pixels.

Species: Brown Pelican (Pelecanus occidentalis). Identifying features to show: very long flat bill with a small hook at the tip; dark throat pouch under the bill, slim when closed; white head with a pale yellow crown; dark chestnut-black hindneck; white stripe down the foreneck; pale eye in a pink-red bare patch. Proportions measured from a photo: bill to head = 4.5; icon bill to head = 3.2. Do not draw: any plume or crest on the head; an oversized bulging pouch; a short bill.
Art director's change for this version: Use the bill and pouch of the first base icon with the clearer eye of the second. Keep the shapes simple enough to read at 64 px. No plume or crest.
